evidence.curator_note: REJECTED pathway: the book crosses out this arrow (an X is drawn through it) and draws NO curved arrows for it -- only the net pieces are shown: R. + a PRIMARY carbocation (H2C+) bearing a neutral, non-conjugated carbonyl (the gamma-H is NOT rearranged). It is disfavored because the charge lands on an unstabilized primary carbon instead of being delocalized onto oxygen; the competing rH -> alpha route (record IMS8-EQ8.9) gives the resonance-stabilized C6H9O+ oxocarbenium of identical mass. Because no arcs are drawn, the electron flow encoded here is the curator's minimal balanced net reaction: the R-C bond breaks homolytically, one electron leaving with R. (move 1) while the second electron migrates to quench the O+. radical to a neutral carbonyl (move 2), leaving the positive charge on the primary carbon. Move 2 registers as a soft 'lone pair rather than radicals' note in the arrow checker (an electron pairs with the O radical: radical count 1 -> 0).

No MOD rule encodes this rejected pathway: rule_index by_equation 8.9 lists only IMS_8_9_1_* and IMS_8_9_2_*, which encode the FAVORED rH -> alpha dienol route (record IMS8-EQ8.9). Correctly, the disfavored primary-carbocation channel is absent from the rule set. m/z 97.0648 (C6H9O+) is computed from the curator's instantiation (R = CH3, X = CH3) and is not printed in the book.
